sections.title: The New Frontier in Anterior Segment Surgery
sections.content: The ESCRS London 2026 Congress marks a pivotal paradigm shift toward custom-tailored refractive cataract procedures. Driven by advancements in Artificial Intelligence formulas, high-precision femtosecond laser platforms, and non-diffractive extended depth of focus (EDOF) intraocular lenses, ophthalmologists are transitioning from standard visual recovery to total refractive optimization. Maximizing surgical accuracy requires a robust clinical understanding of preoperative biometry, patient-specific ocular surface health, intraoperative micro-segmentation, and advanced complication management strategies.

references.citation: Kohnen T. Refractive Cataract Surgery: The New Standard. Journal of Cataract & Refractive Surgery. 2025.

sections.title: Management Algorithm for Intraoperative Floppy Iris Syndrome (IFIS)
content: Step 1: Preoperative Identification - Discontinue alpha-1 blockers (e.g., Tamsulosin) and document systemic risk.
Step 2: Intracameral Malyugin/Shugarcaine - Administer preservative-free epinephrine/lidocaine mixture to optimize iris tone.
Step 3: Visco-mydriasis - Employ high-viscosity cohesive OVD (e.g., Healon5) to mechanically dilate and stabilize.
Step 4: Mechanical Expansion - If pupil remains under 4.0mm, insert a 6.25mm or 7.0mm Malyugin Ring or pupil diamond expanders.
Step 5: Low-Fluidic Parameters - Reduce aspiration flow rate (AFR) and vacuum to minimize iris prolapse into the phaco tip.

references.citation: Chang DF, et al. Intraoperative floppy-iris syndrome associated with tamsulosin. JCRS. 2005.

sections.title: Surgical Mastery: Managing the Subluxated Lens
content: Step 1: Gentle Capsulorhexis - Initiate off-center, use micro-forceps, consider tangential forces to preserve compromised zonules.
Step 2: Capsular Anchor Placement - Use temporary iris/capsular hooks to stabilize the capsular bag equator during phacoemulsification.
Step 3: Cortical Cleaving Hydrodissection - Avoid vigorous hydrodissection; use slow, gentle fluid waves to prevent bag-zonule detachment.
Step 4: Capsular Tension Ring (CTR/CTS) - Insert CTR (e.g., 11C or 12C) for under 4 clock hours of loss; use Cionni CTS for larger defects.
Step 5: Scleral Fixation Protocol - Perform Yamane double-needle technique using 30G thin-wall needles and 6-0 Prolene or PVDF suture.

references.citation: Yamane S, et al. Flanged Intrascleral Intraocular Lens Fixation with Double-Needle Technique. Ophthalmology. 2017.

sections.title: Premium IOL Astigmatism Correction & Toric Alignment Pearls

rows: Posterior Corneal Astigmatism (PCA)
Overestimating with-the-rule (WTR) and underestimating against-the-rule (ATR) astigmatism without PCA calculations.
Use Barrett Toric Calculator or Abulafia-Koch regression formulas.
Prevent residual postoperative cylinder errors
Intraoperative Digital Guidance
Manual ink marking can lead to significant rotational misalignment (up to 5-10 degrees).
Utilize digital overlays (e.g., Callisto Eye or Verion) linked to preoperative keratometry.
Maintain toric alignment within 3 degrees of target axis
Complete OVD Removal
Retained ophthalmic viscosurgical device behind the IOL causes early postoperative rotation.
Thoroughly aspirate cohesive OVD from behind the optic; gently press IOL against posterior capsule.
Abolish postoperative rotational instability
SIA Personalization
Inaccurate Surgically Induced Astigmatism (SIA) assumptions degrade refractive outcomes.
Calculate personal SIA using online registries with at least 20-50 clean postoperative cases.
Achieve predictable, sub-0.25D postoperative cylinder

references.citation: Abulafia A, et al. Regression formulas for predicting postoperative toric intraocular lens refractive outcomes. JCRS. 2016.

sections.title: Post-Cataract Endophthalmitis and TASS Prevention
content: Preoperative 5% Povidone-Iodine: Instill in conjunctival sac for at least 3 minutes prior to surgical draping.
Intracameral Cefuroxime (1.0mg/0.1ml) or Moxifloxacin (0.5mg/0.1ml): Essential at the conclusion of surgery to reduce endophthalmitis risk up to 5-fold.
Wound Integrity Validation: Ensure all clear corneal incisions (CCIs) are fully hydrated and watertight to prevent postoperative fluid influx.
Sterilization and TASS Guardrails: Avoid enzymatic detergents for intraocular instruments; enforce strict single-use cannula protocols to prevent Toxic Anterior Segment Syndrome.

references.citation: ESCRS Endophthalmitis Study Group. Prophylaxis of postoperative endophthalmitis in cataract surgery. JCRS. 2007.

sections.title: Surgical Decision-Making in Glaucoma: MIGS Selection Matrix

branches: Trabecular Bypass: iStent inject W or Hydrus Microstent (Best for mild-to-moderate POAG combined with phaco)
Canalicular Dilatation: OMNI Surgical System or iTrack (Addresses multiple points of resistance)
Subconjunctival Filtration: PreserFlo MicroShunt or Xen Gel Stent (For moderate-to-severe POAG, target lower IOPs)
Suprachoroidal Shunt: Miniject (Alternative pathway, avoids bleb complications)

references.citation: Lavia C, et al. Minimally-invasive glaucoma surgeries (MIGS). Eye. 2017.

sections.title: Post-Operative Premium IOL Visual Troubleshooting Mnemonic

content.explanation: F - Fluctuation of Vision (dry eye, tear film instability); O - Out of focus (residual refractive error/astigmatism); C - Capsule opacification (PCO, treat with YAG capsulotomy); U - Under-pupil centration (check for IOL tilt or decentration); S - Surface disease (meibomian gland dysfunction, treat aggressively).

references.citation: Bafna S, et al. Management of postoperative patient dissatisfaction with premium intraocular lenses. JCRS. 2021.

sections.title: Key Clinical Pearls: Premium IOL Patient Selection
content: Screen for Macular Disease: Do not implant diffractive multifocal or EDOF IOLs in patients with ERM, AMD, or severe DME; choose enhanced monofocals instead.
Analyze Higher-Order Aberrations (HOAs): Patients with corneal coma or trefoil > 0.3 µm are poor candidates for diffractive optics; prioritize wavefront-optimized monofocals.
Identify Personality Profiles: Highly meticulous, demanding patients (e.g., engineers, pilots) are highly sensitive to micro-dysphotopsias. Educate extensively.
Prioritize Dry Eye Therapy: Optimize the ocular surface before obtaining final biometry; a dry cornea can alter K-readings by > 1.0 Diopter, causing refractive surprise.

references.citation: Gibbons A, et al. Patient selection for premium intraocular lenses. Eye. 2016.

sections.title: Landmark Clinical Trials Shaping Modern Practice
sections.content: Clinical protocols in 2026 are heavily guided by several massive, multi-center trials. The ESCRS PREVEX Trial established the safety profile of immediate sequential bilateral cataract surgery (ISBCS) when strict sterile separation protocols are met. The EUREQUO Database Analysis, monitoring over 1 million cataract procedures, demonstrated that the use of intracameral cefuroxime remains the single most effective prophylactic intervention against endophthalmitis, while highlighting a progressive decline in capsule complications globally. Furthermore, the multi-center COPPER study validated that advanced AI-based formula ensembles significantly reduce the incidence of hyperopic surprise in post-refractive surgery patients compared to classic paraxial ray-tracing.

references.citation: Herrero-Vanrell R, et al. ESCRS Registry Database annual report. JCRS. 2024.
